data.title: Sew for breast cancer support at Dusit Central Park
data.description: Dusit International invites you to sew for a cause during "Synergy For Her: Weaving Care, Creating Happiness For Society", at Suan Dusit Arun, Dusit Central Park, Rama IV Road, on Thursday from 4.30pm to 6.30pm.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 29
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Royal barges on show at  'Colors, A Reflection Of Creation'
data.description: The splendour of the Royal Barge Procession is presented through the exhibition "Colors, A Reflection Of Creation", which is running at Iconluxe, M floor of Iconsiam, Charoen Nakhon Road, until Nov 8.

data.title: A new Asean dictionary awaits  at 'A-Z Of Southeast Asian Art'
data.description: Established by the Creador Foundation, Muara Arts -- a new non-profit institution dedicated to Southeast Asian contemporary art -- will launch in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on Nov 1 with its inaugural exhibition "A-Z Of Southeast Asian Art: A Critical Dictionary".

data.title: Rethinking stroke care
data.description: According to the Ministry of Public Health, the number of stroke patients treated in public hospitals has been continually increasing: approximately 135,600 in 2023, 146,300 in 2024 and 162,000 in 2025.

data.title: Hospital battles rising waters
data.description: Rayong: Flooding in Klaeng district worsened on Monday after water from the Prasae River inundated low-lying areas and Klaeng Hospital, disrupting operations and cutting off normal food and supply deliveries.

data.title: War Elephants eye revenge on Vietnam
data.description: Revenge is on the menu in Bandung Tuesday night as the War Elephants, with wounded pride to restore, come face to face with Vietnam again, the side that beat them in the Asean Hyundai Cup final.

data.title: Cabinet backs B497m AI-powered weather scheme
data.description: The cabinet has approved a 497-million-baht project for fiscal 2027 to bring satellite and AI-powered weather forecasting from US climate technology company Tomorrow.io to the Thai Meteorological Department.

data.title: Govt ramps up flood aid
data.description: The government has instructed all agencies to prepare medical personnel, medicines, and mobile medical teams to assist in flood-affected areas, said Public Health permanent secretary Somreuk Juengsamarn.

data.title: Ministry moves to help ease shortages
data.description: Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has ordered the ministry to closely monitor supplies and prices in flood-affected areas and coordinate deliveries to communities where flooding has disrupted transport.

data.title: Rain wreaks havoc as it moves west
data.description: Kanchanaburi: Heavy rain has triggered widespread flooding across Kanchanaburi, forcing more than 400 households to evacuate, disrupting power and communications and leaving a mother and daughter missing after their pickup truck was swept away by floodwaters.

data.title: PM to submit B165bn water diversion plan
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will submit a 165-billion-baht project to divert water from Chai Nat through the Pasak River and onwards to the Gulf of Thailand to the cabinet on Tuesday, as the government seeks a long-term solution to recurring flooding in Bangkok and the lower Chao Phraya Basin.

data.title: Jet ski seized after flood stunt
data.description: The Bangkok North Municipal Court on Monday confiscated a jet ski and handed a suspended jail term to a man whose ride through floodwaters on Phetchaburi Road drew widespread criticism on social media.

data.title: Pope says concerns about AI 'should be taken seriously'
data.description: ABOARD THE PAPAL PLANE - Pope Leo XIV on Monday warned concerns about artificial intelligence "should be taken seriously" but added he was not in "panic mode".

data.title: Govt allots B2bn for relief effort
data.description: The government has set aside 2 billion baht from the 2026 central budget to assist people affected by flooding nationwide, including Bangkok, PM's Office Minister Paradorn Prissananantakul said on Monday.

data.title: Ballot codes get court nod
data.description: The Constitutional Court has upheld the use of QR codes and barcodes on ballots in the Feb 8 general election, ruling that safeguards against tracing votes to individual voters were sufficient to protect ballot secrecy.

data.title: Rain to ease over next 3 days
data.description: Bangkok authorities will step up drainage over the next three days as rainfall is forecast to ease, with Governor Chadchart Sittipunt saying on Monday that the water level in major canals could fall within two days.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi sees 900m passengers
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport has handled almost 900 million passengers since opening 20 years ago, with the airport expanding the use of automated systems and other technology as passenger traffic continues to grow.

data.title: SpaceX puts Starship megarocket in orbit for first time
data.description: SOUTH PADRE ISLAND (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's Starship megarocket reached orbit for the first time on Monday after blasting off from Texas, in a major milestone for SpaceX's future plans, including trips to the Moon and Mars.

data.title: Dozens kidnapped in two weekend attacks in northern Nigeria
data.description: GUSAU (NIGERIA) - More than 80 people, mostly women, were missing Monday after being abducted by armed gangs in two separate weekend attacks in northern Nigeria, the latest mass kidnappings to rock the country.

data.title: Russia pummels Kyiv in latest deadly daytime attack
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian drones crashed into Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences in the historic heart of Kyiv on Monday, in the latest deadly daytime attack on the Ukrainian capital.

data.title: Seoul says North Korean mines 'highly suspected' as cause of DMZ blast
data.description: SEOUL - A blast that injured three South Korean military officers inside the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) last week was likely caused by North Korean landmines, Seoul's military said Monday.

data.title: Kunlavut’s high, Pitchamon’s low
data.description: Thailand’s badminton camp found light amid the gloom on Monday as former world champion Kunlavut Vitidsarn swept into the men’s singles final in Nagoya, making history as the first Thai to do so, on the same day the B sample of teenage teammate Pitchamon Opatniputh confirmed her positive test for a banned substance.

data.title: Hurricane Polo approaches Mexico, threatens severe damage
data.description: PUERTO SAN CARLOS — Hurricane Polo is expected to make landfall on Monday in a small town off Mexico's Pacific coast, where authorities expect heavy rain and severe damage.

data.title: Madrid housing protesters vow to maintain pressure on government
data.description: MADRID — Demonstrators camping in a central Madrid square vowed Monday to keep up the pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez over Spain's housing crisis, as the 87-year-old woman at the centre of the protest called on them to "hold on".

data.title: UK police probe Iran link to air base bomb scare
data.description: FAIRFORD (UNITED KINGDOM) - British counter-terror police were reportedly probing Iran's possible role in a bomb scare at an air base used by the US on Monday, with five men detained suspected of planning a "terrorist act".

data.title: Comedian on trial for allegedly insulting Turkish president in standup show
data.description: ISTANBUL - A popular Turkish comedian has been put on trial for allegedly insulting President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and other offences during a stand-up performance, offering a quick-witted defence that had much of the courtroom in stitches.

data.title: Death toll in South Africa bar shooting rises to 18
data.description: JOHANNESBURG — The death toll in a mass shooting in a South African tavern has risen to 18 after one person died in hospital, police said Monday, adding that at least two of the dead were Lesotho nationals.

data.title: Colombian police capture wife, daughter of Ecuador drug lord
data.description: BOGOTá - Colombian police have arrested the wife and daughter of one of Ecuador's most powerful drug lords who was extradited to the United States last year, President Abelardo de la Espriella said Sunday.

data.title: Court upholds Feb 8 election, rejects objection to coded ballots
data.description: The Constitutional Court on Monday ruled that ballots with barcodes and QR codes were designed for effective election supervision and did not violate voters' rights and liberties protected by the Constitution.
